name: gmail-wiki-ingest
description: Triage a batch of the user's email against their personal knowledge wiki and hand the verdicts back to javis-server, which bands them into auto-ingest / review card / auto-discard. Runs daily on an in-container openclaw cron agent turn, and on demand. Four script commands (fetch / content / submit / report) call javis-server with the container's gateway token; bodies are read for at most 12 threads a run, only ones the server already offered, and never persisted. Bands, sender trust, ref validation and every write stay server-side, and rubric.md owns the judgment so it can change without a deploy. Every run ends in one markdown digest pushed to the user's chat — the agent writes the headline, the script renders every server-issued fact and escapes every subject line. Triggers: 'ingest my email', 'gmail ingest', '整理邮件', '邮件入库'.
